Geometric and combinatorial proofs independently check each boundary; Python checker reproduces polynomial identities. No infinite theorem is inferred from finite samples.

value.rationale: The binary-quadratic resultant is a natural minimal universal incidence hypersurface; its reduced Segre singular support misses a full embedded quadric with rank-two conormal square-zero structure in characteristic two. Exact module and Hilbert polynomial are natural scheme-theoretic invariants useful for studying modular discriminant degenerations and deformation behavior, rather than arbitrary isolated numbers.
